title: Properties of countable derived products
statement: Assume the hypotheses of lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core and countable products in the derived category. Then every termwise product cone is limiting after Q and every homology functor preserves countable discrete limits.

proof.text: Exact products identify cycles, boundaries and homology of termwise products. Product quasi-isomorphisms and the localization fraction calculus transfer the termwise universal property to the derived category and identify the homology limit comparison.

theorem derivedCategory_countableProducts_properties
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableProducts A] [CountableAB4Star A]
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)] :
      (∀ (J : Type t) [Countable J] (C : J → CochainComplex A ℤ),
        Nonempty (IsLimit (DerivedCategory.Q.mapCone (limit.cone (Discrete.functor C))))) ∧
      (∀ (J : Type t) [Countable J] (p : ℤ),
        PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete J) (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A p))
